title: Extension methods and static state
description:
Write extension methods in a static class `TextExtensions`:

```csharp
public static bool IsPalindrome(this string text)          // ignoring case and anything that is not a letter or digit
public static int WordCount(this string text)              // runs of non-space characters
public static string Abbreviate(this string text, int max) // cut at a word boundary and end with "...", within max characters
public static double Median(this IEnumerable<int> values)  // throws InvalidOperationException when empty
```

and a static class `Ids` that hands out ids per prefix:

```csharp
Ids.Next("order");     // "order-1"
Ids.Next("order");     // "order-2"
Ids.Next("user");      // "user-1"
Ids.Reset();           // all counters back to the start
```

`Abbreviate` returns the text unchanged when it fits in `max`. Otherwise it keeps as many whole words as fit together with `"..."` (words separated by single spaces in the result) and adds `"..."`; if not even the first word fits, it returns just the first `max - 3` characters plus `"..."`.
hints: An extension method is a `static` method in a `static` class whose first parameter starts with `this`: `public static int WordCount(this string text)`.
For the median of an even count, average the two middle values as doubles: adding two large `int`s first would overflow.
lessonTitle: Static Members, Extension Methods and Namespaces
